==Dialogue==
:''"King Jahnus was a cruel tyrant with no respect for his people or his servants. When I overheard that he planned to entomb us alongside his rotting corpse once we reached the burial site, I could not stand by and just let it happen. I had to do something. So we ran...right into these sulfur pits. I see now the folly of our actions, but at least we weren't buried alive."''
